_readme: Prompt registry: the session engine looks prompts up by key; zero hardcoded copy in code. {page_chars}/{max_turns}/{catalog}/{hint}/{depth}/{tail_page}/{page_no}/{page_text}/{attempt_left}/{missing}/{roll_no}/{max_rolls}/{summaries_block}/{pages_read}/{page_total} in text are placeholders. summary_contract constrains the chatlog summary side-call.

remind.text: Reminder: the context window is nearly exhausted; converge and publish soon.

force_publish.text: The context limit has been reached; publish your conclusion via publish now.

force_publish_only.text: Only publish is allowed; read_page is forbidden. Publish your conclusion now.

bad_json_retry.text: Your previous output was not valid contract JSON ({attempt_left} tolerances left); please output it again.

publish_retry.text: Your publish output is malformed (identity problem: {missing}). Output the publish action again as one complete JSON object with the full identity (title, category, summary, tags, language, confidence); re-input chances left: {attempt_left}.

dup_page.text: {why}; choose another page or publish directly.

stall_to_publish.text: Page-turning has stalled; publish your current conclusion via publish now.

chatlog_summarize.text: The conversation context is approaching the limit. Summarize the conversation so far as one JSON object with a single key "summary": a compact digest covering the pages read and their key information, the current progress toward a conclusion, and the follow-up plan. Keep it under 4000 characters. Output exactly one JSON object.

chatlog_roll.text:
===== Chatlog context · round {roll_no}/{max_rolls} =====
Earlier conversation, compacted into digests (raw messages archived on disk):

{summaries_block}
